Creates an empty mesh with no surfaces, vertices or triangles. Fill it with [CreateSurface](CreateSurface), [AddVertex](AddVertex) and [AddTriangle](AddTriangle) to build your own geometry, or with [AddMesh](AddMesh) to put other meshes together.

```blitzbasic
;media still blitz3d/createmesh.png
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -4
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 20, 20, 0
mesh = CreateMesh()
surf = CreateSurface(mesh)
a = AddVertex(surf, -1.5, -1, 0)
b = AddVertex(surf, 0, 1.2, 0)
c = AddVertex(surf, 1.5, -1, 0)
AddTriangle surf, a, b, c
UpdateNormals mesh
EntityColor mesh, 240, 120, 80
EntityFX mesh, 16
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

![CreateMesh](media/blitz3d/createmesh.png)
@param parent  Entity the mesh follows, or 0 for none. Defaults to 0.
@returns       The handle of the new mesh.
